# Mints Global

> Mints Global is a premium digital agency headquartered in Dubai, UAE, operating globally. We deliver ROI-driven Digital Marketing, enterprise-grade Software Development, and military-grade Cyber Security to brands across the Middle East, Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, and worldwide. Founded in 2020. 250+ projects delivered across 20+ countries. 98% client retention.

- Website: https://mintsglobal.ae
- Email: info@mintsglobal.ae
- WhatsApp: +971 502943916
- Languages: English · Arabic · German
- Currencies: AED · USD · EUR · GBP
- Time Zone: GMT+4 (Dubai) — overlaps with both European and Asian business hours

## What We Do

Mints Global operates across three divisions — Digital Marketing, Software Development, and Cyber Security — serving startups, SMEs, and enterprise clients on every continent. Our dual-market position in Dubai gives us a unique bridge between Middle Eastern business culture and Western compliance standards (GDPR, ISO 27001, NIS2, PCI-DSS).
